farmers-world.description: Farmers World, trading as Surbola N.V., is Suriname's best known supplier of veterinary medicine and livestock supplies. The Lelydorp store on Indira Gandhiweg stocks animal health products, vaccines and treatments for poultry, cattle, pigs and small livestock, alongside feed supplements, farming tools, agricultural machinery and spare parts. Farmers across Wanica and Saramacca come here as much for the staff's product advice as for the stock itself.

brasa-suriname.description: Brasa is a Brazilian steakhouse on the Anton Dragtenweg in Paramaribo that calls itself the “Brazilian Steak Avenue”. The menu centres on churrasco-style grilled steaks and sausages, with seafood on the side, served in a lively setting that mixes Brazilian and Surinamese hospitality. Regular music nights accompany dinner; reservations go through WhatsApp.

wan-bon-biri.description: Stadsbrouwerij met proeflokaal, outdoor seating, Bar&Grill

dansclub-danzson.description: Dansclub DanzSon – Dance, Connection & Experience With over 25 years of experience, DANSCLUB DANZSON brings people together through dance, music, relaxation and fun. We provide interactive dance workshops and group experiences for businesses, hotels, organizations and special events. Our focus is on engagement, interaction and connection. Rather than traditional performances, we create energetic experiences where guests, clients and employees actively participate, encouraging team spirit and lasting memories. Our Services • Corporate team-building activities • Interactive hotel guest experiences • Family Days & employee activities • Event and seminar energizers • Themed dance experiences • Wedding dance coaching • Private lessons & group sessions Experience & Expertise Our experience includes national and international dance achievements, internationally certified dance instruction and working with diverse audiences. We offer Salsa, Bachata, Kizomba, Zouk, Samba, Cha-Cha-Cha, Merengue, Mambo, Semba, Kompa and more. Surinamese dance styles can also be incorporated for a unique cultural experience. All sessions are beginner-friendly and require no prior dance experience. Activities can take place at your venue or in our fully air-conditioned studio. Employee Wellness Programs Dance is an enjoyable way to promote physical activity, reduce stress and strengthen social connections. Companies can support employee participation in our regular classes or arrange exclusive monthly programs for employees and their families at special corporate rates. We welcome opportunities to create tailor-made experiences for your organization. stichting-boekoe.description: Kibrimi is ons guesthouse op de ‘pranasi’ van Boisa Pinas. Hij is een trotse Marron en basya van Pikien Santi, gelegen aan de rechteroever van de Cottica, midden in de natuur. De bossen en kreken die voorheen het decor vormden van de vrijheidsstrijd van de Boni-Marrons zijn nog maagdelijk en kennen een grote diversiteit aan flora en fauna. Het verblijf is basic, heeft de voorzieningen zoals elektra, stromend (drink)water, bedden, toilet met douche en keuken. Bezoekers kunnen er zelfvoorzienend verblijven en ook afspraken maken met de lokale beheerder Rovell Pinas over vervoer, maaltijden en jungletrips.
stichting-boekoe.name: Kibrimi / Boekoe

bergh-bedrijven-nv.description: Bergh & Bedrijven N.V. is een consultancybedrijf gespecialiseerd in bedrijfsstrategie, marketing, management en digitale oplossingen. Wij helpen organisaties groeien, innoveren en duurzaam resultaat behalen.

act-contractors-nv.description: ACT Contractors N.V. is a construction and engineering company in Paramaribo offering building and civil construction, renovation, design and build, heavy equipment rental, landscaping, cleaning services and project consulting. Its projects include agricultural, resort, residential and telecommunications work in several districts of Suriname.
